investigation.likely_cause: The /data volume on the subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is 100% full, with the transaction log archive (/data/txlog_archive, 8.5 GiB) as the largest folder. 8.5 GiB was written across 34 files in the last 15 minutes, which looks like a catch-up run writing many archives at once rather than database growth. Free space is below the 256 MiB threshold, so the database refuses writes. That caused the write errors on all schemas, the API errors on api-balance and api-bundle, the USSD timeouts and synthetic failures, and the SMS queue growth.
